newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba allots 82.1 bln dmk repos, drains funds.
newsitem.headline: Buba allots 82.1 bln dmk repos, drains funds.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Wednesday it had awarded 82.1 billion marks in securities repurchase funds at this week's tender at a fixed rate of three percent.

The central bank accepted 30.4 percent of the bids for the 14-day funds. A repo pact for 84.0 billion marks at a fixed three percent rate expires today, Wednesday, so a net 1.9 billion marks is draining from the market.
The Bundesbank said banks bid for 270.1 billion marks of the repurchase funds this week.
